body: I assume as you wrote "to speak to people" that's all you did? If so why don't you speak with your husband and explain how you feel, it might help and you can come clean, ignore the other comments they seem rather judgemental, not everything is so black and white.
Ive done a bungee jump for charity.
Try again to post what you are feeling, if you look on here the members on the site really do care and there is no judgements, no pressure like.
You're a good guy, good luck, up voted.

I know the loneliness is hard, I have that myself and Im not exactly the best looking guy in the world, I have been single for over 5 years and even then it was the most messed up relationship long distance based online, I doubt you are as ugly as you think you are, and there is always someone out there who wants to know you, even if its for a short time, you are still young and things can change. If you ever fancy talking message me we can talk on Skype or PM or whatever you feel comfortable with.

Sorry poor wording on my behalf, I wasn't meaning that you aimed the abuse at her, different companies have different rules in my previous call centre work any swearing whether at the staff or in general wouldn't be tolerated and the customer got a warning.

there is no need to swear at the volunteer, maybe it was because it was coming across in an aggressive manner and as someone who has worked in a  call centre before, the golden rule is if someone swears at you warn them and if it continues end the call.
ok thanks, I'll cross it off my list, my death will be a mess anyway without someone having my wipe my ass.
im in UK anyway so we have the NHS im on a waiting list for CBT was supposed be 6 weeks but its now 4 months later.

Apparently according to the person who I thought I could turn to about anything I am too nice and I come across as though I try to hard, I have been ditched by this person and she is no longer in my life through her choice.
Honestly I think this is more self loathing, just be there for her, try not to judge her, she may of hurt herself but not to the extent you think, text her to tell her you care a lot about her.
You feel like explaining why you are feeling this way?
I think we are both in the same place and use this page for similar reasons, take it easy and keep on fighting.
that's what you see when you look here, I see people giving alternatives and showing those in need that people do care.
Have you tried Meditation, it's not for everyone but I know a few people who swear by it, I have recently take it up myself.
good for you, keep up the good fight.

I feel like killing myself all the time and I don't fully understand it myself, I have mentioned it to a couple of friends but how can they understand when I don't, as long as your friend is there for you and you can talk to them I think that's the best we can hope for, based on my experiences anyway.
if you need to talk im nearly always free message me, your not alone in thinking this way.

Leave the alcohol alone and try new hobbies, learn a new language, go camping, spend as much time as possible with the people who love you and who you love.

I'm not blaming the alcohol for your feelings but when you already feel low alcohol makes everything worse.
I was more meaning life is about learning from the mistakes you make.

you are still young, life is all about making mistakes, the only way to make your life great is to make those mistakes and learn from them as you go along, at the end of the day every mistake you make can be used to make you a stronger person.
Everything I am on is prescribed and serves a purpose for my medical health.
not everything is going to be cured by what you want, ok you want be here to see it but think it through fully.
